name: Currents of the Cosmos
source:
The God of the Moon reflects light, but beneath his glittering surface, he harbors a dark secret. Can you discover its origin before it's too late?

[From [url=https://nix-hydra-games.itch.io/for-the-love-of-gods/devlog/290820/currents-of-the-cosmos]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
月神映照着光芒，可在闪耀的表面之下，他却藏着一个黑暗的秘密。你能在一切为时已晚之前，查明这个秘密的起因吗？

[摘自[url=https://nix-hydra-games.itch.io/for-the-love-of-gods/devlog/290820/currents-of-the-cosmos]itch.io[/url]]
